brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese editorial basketball article thumbnail, PNG, landscape 16:9, target 1536 x 864 pixels (width at least 1000 pixels). All lettering and artwork are to be rendered together by image generation.

ARTICLE FACTS — use only these: The fixed article's date is 2026.10.27. There are no games on that day for B.PREMIER, B.ONE, and B.NEXT. The data were retrieved on 2026-10-28 at 18:27 JST. Official records and announcements may be corrected. No named athlete, score, statistic, winner, cancellation, postponement or actual game scene is supported.

STYLE: Approved バスケまとめ visual style: deep charcoal black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B dry-brush strokes, warm off-white extremely bold Japanese sans-serif headline, hand-drawn ink and coarse brush illustration, energetic but uncluttered, limited elements. Strong editorial contrast and crisp readable Japanese type. Do not reproduce any names, numbers, players, team marks or scores from previous thumbnails.

COMPOSITION: Wide rectangle, safe 55px outer margins. Left two-thirds hold a powerful typographic block: the small publication label at top, the date in large off-white type below, then the HUGE dominant lime headline 試合なし (one line). Below the headline, the three league names on one readable off-white line. Right third: one orange basketball resting on an empty abstract court, drawn with bold black ink hatching and dry-brush texture; a restrained diagonal lime brush accent behind it, a few off-white court lines. This is symbolic illustration, not a depiction of an actual event. No people, faces, hands, players, uniforms, logos, sponsors or photographic imagery. Preserve generous negative space and no overlap between words and illustration.

TEXT — render these exact strings, with no spelling changes, no extra labels and no made-up text:
Top small: "バスケまとめ"
Date large: "2026.10.27"
Main headline largest: "試合なし"
Leagues below: "B.PREMIER・B.ONE・B.NEXT"
Bottom information line: "資料取得：2026-10-28 18:27 JST"
Bottom qualifier line: "公式記録・発表は訂正される場合があります"
Bottom credit line, two phrases separated by a generous gap: "イラスト（AI生成）" and "成績をもとにしたイメージ"

Keep the three bottom information/qualifier/credit lines high-contrast off-white, approximately 26–30px at 1536px width, clean horizontal type with ample spacing. All text must remain within the canvas and be clearly readable. Do not suggest that all basketball everywhere has no games; make the three named leagues prominent. Avoid calendars with fabricated weekday cells, scoreboards, decorative numerical marks, cancellation crosses, watermarks, or extra text.
